title: Mix checklist
body:
# Mix checklist

- Peaks around -18 dBFS on every track.
- Master: -1 dBTP ceiling, about -14 LUFS for streaming.

## Mix bus order

1. EQ
2. Compressor
3. Limiter

title: Session checklist
body:
# Session checklist

- Set the sample rate to match the interface.
- Buffer size low while recording, high while mixing.
- Start from your template.
- Name every track before the first take.
- Export the mixdown at the end.
